title: A ring, nothing, or a kitchen sound, then "Hello?"
description: The assistant is silent after answering a question. Then the user says "Hello?". In version 1 a telephone rang just before, so "Hello?" is meant for the caller (do not respond). In version 2 nothing happened and in version 3 a pot rattled in the kitchen, so "Hello?" is meant for the assistant (respond). The words are identical in all three versions; only the sound differs.

speech.text: How can I air-dry heavy towels in my tiny apartment without making it damp?

assistant.text: Run an extra spin cycle first, then hang towels separately with plenty of space between them. Use an exhaust fan or dehumidifier, and keep the rack away from walls.
